limitations: Exactly two exposed calibration-development fits, not independent generalization or physical-device qualification.
First-order point-source rectangular-room simulation with no higher orders, diffraction, occlusion or spatial source directivity.
Coordinate frame exact by construction; mapping receiver survey errors independent of reference/source calibration and audio errors.
No new calibration fit, raw-reference regeneration, seed search or threshold tuning.
reporting_issue: Frozen results rms_s/max_abs_s are unique-only subset statistics when incomplete. Audit complete_rms_s/complete_max_abs_s remain null; no acceptance/benefit uses incomplete sets.
